column1: Jukebox: add a shuffle button for the built-in tunes
column3: The jukebox cycles its four lo-fi tunes in order. A **Shuffle** toggle next to **Next track** would pick the next tune at random, and stay on for the floor (in `jukebox.json`) so every window hears the same thing.

column1: Coffee meter should pulse when the buzz is about to wear off
column3: The little meter under the project name drains quietly. In its last 10 seconds it should pulse orange, so you know to grab another cup before the jitters window closes.

column1: Elevator panel: show each floor's open PR count
column3: The elevator lists busy and waiting workers per floor. Add the number of open pull requests next to them, so you can see which project has reviews piling up before you ride there.

column1: Pipelines board colors a cancelled run red instead of grey
column3: A run cancelled by a newer push shows on the Pipelines board in the same red as a failure. Cancelled should be a neutral grey, matching GitHub, so real failures stand out.

column1: Arcade high-score table should show when each score was set
column3: BLOCKFALL's building-wide high scores list the name and score. Add a short date (`Oct 9`) to each row so a fresh score is easy to spot.

column1: Command palette: match worker names by their initials
column3: With a dozen workers, typing `bb` in the palette should find **Big Byte**. Match initials as well as substrings, ranked after exact prefix matches.

column1: Bookshelf lists README twice when docs/ links to it
column3: When `docs/index.md` symlinks to the root `README.md`, the bookshelf shows two copies of the same doc. Dedupe by real path.

column1: Help window: document the BLOCKFALL controls
column3: The arcade's controls (arrows/WASD, Space to drop, C to hold, P to pause) are only on the cabinet. List them in the Help window's controls table too.

column1: Weather: add a sandstorm kind for --weather
column3: `--weather` takes clear, cloudy, rain, storm, snow or fog. A sandstorm (orange haze, blowing grit past the windows) would suit the Factory palette.

column1: Workers panel: sort by status, waiting first
column3: The 🤖 Workers panel lists workers by desk. Add a sort that puts *needs input* first, then *done*, then *working*, so the panel doubles as a triage list.
